title: 슬픔을 견디는 세 가지 방법 — 『포르투갈의 높은 산』 딥다이브
es: We need stories to survive the truth.
videoTitle: Surviving Grief in High Mountains of Portugal
summary: 두 진행자가 『파이 이야기』의 작가 얀 마텔의 소설 『포르투갈의 높은 산』을 세 부분으로 따라가며, 산산조각 난 삶을 사람들이 어떻게 견디는지 이야기해요. 1904년 가족을 잃고 세상에 항의하듯 뒤로 걷다가 자동차로 십자가를 찾아 나선 토마스(도망치기), 1938년 섣달그믐 밤 아내의 유령과 애거사 크리스티와 복음서를 비교하고 '어떻게 살았는지 보여 달라'는 부검을 맡은 병리학자 에우제비우(해부하기), 1981년 상원을 그만두고 침팬지 오도와 포르투갈 마을로 떠난 피터(현재에 머물기). '우리는 타락한 천사가 아니라 일어선 유인원', 포르투갈에는 높은 산이 없다는 역설, 엇갈린 독자 평가까지 다뤄요.
topics: Part 1 Homeless — walking backward · the crucifix · the automobile
Part 2 Homeward — Agatha Christie and the Gospels · "Why would truth use the tools of fiction?"
the spiritual autopsy · magical realism · "This is home."
Part 3 Home — Peter, Odo the chimpanzee · risen apes, not fallen angels
mountains in the mind · polarized reviews
구문: not just A, it's B · instead of -ing · rather than · if … what … would … · 비평의 언어

grammar.title: ① 세 남자, 슬픔을 견디는 세 가지 방식
grammar.lead: 소설의 세 부분을 한 표로 정리해요.

head: 부
인물 · 시대
방식과 핵심 문장
rows: 도망치기 — You cannot outrun grief in a motor car.
거리 두기 vs. 뛰어들기 — We need stories to survive the truth.
현재에 머물기 — a state of blessed detachment

grammar.tip: We cannot outthink our pain, and we cannot outrun it. But we can learn to carry it.

grammar.title: ② out- + 동사 — ~보다 더 …해서 이기다
examples: You cannot outrun grief in a motor car.
자동차로 슬픔을 따돌릴 수는 없어요.
We cannot outthink our pain, and we cannot outrun it.
고통을 생각으로 이길 수도, 달려서 따돌릴 수도 없어요.

grammar.title: ③ It's not just A. It's B. — A가 아니라 B다
grammar.lead: 앞의 해석을 받아서 더 깊은 해석을 내놓을 때 써요.
examples: So it's not just a passive short circuit, it's an active protest.
그러니까 수동적인 합선이 아니라 적극적인 항의네요.
It's not just a frantic quest. It's a man operating with a blown fuse.
그냥 미친 듯한 탐색이 아니라, 퓨즈가 나간 채로 움직이는 남자예요.
The autopsy is a spiritual dissection, not a medical one.
그 부검은 의학적 해부가 아니라 영적인 해부예요.

grammar.title: ④ 비평의 언어 — excoriate · strain · flat · a cop-out
grammar.lead: 책 리뷰를 말할 때 쓰는 표현이에요. 칭찬과 비판을 둘 다 익혀요.

head: 표현
뜻
예문
rows: The review from The Guardian excoriates this scene.
The writing strains and fails to evoke feeling.
Some readers found the three-part structure disjointed.
The theological debates made it preachy.
They compared it very favorably to Life of Pi.

grammar.title: ⑤ 강조 구문 — It is … that … / What … is …
examples: What's fascinating is how Martel chooses to depict this.
흥미로운 건 마텔이 이걸 그리는 방식이에요.
What Martel undeniably achieves is forcing the reader to confront the mechanics of survival.
마텔이 부정할 수 없이 해낸 건 독자가 생존의 원리와 마주하게 만든 거예요.
That higher consciousness is exactly what makes grief so unbearable.
그 고차원 의식이 바로 슬픔을 견딜 수 없게 만드는 거예요.

grammar.title: ⑥ 대비 — instead of · not A but B · the exact opposite
grammar.lead: 두 인물의 태도를 대비할 때 쓰는 표현이에요.
examples: Instead of investigating a physical crime scene, he is investigating the human heart.
물리적인 범죄 현장 대신 인간의 마음을 수사해요.
She doesn't want to know how he died. She wants Eusébio to show her how he lived.
어떻게 죽었는지가 아니라 어떻게 살았는지 보여 주길 원해요.
Eusébio approaches death with clinical detachment. But Maria Castro does the exact opposite.
에우제비우는 임상적 거리 두기로 다가가지만, 마리아 카스트루는 정반대로 해요.

grammar.title: ⑦ 마무리 질문 — If someone were to …, what would …?
examples: Imagine for a moment that someone were to perform an autopsy on your life.
잠깐, 누군가 당신의 삶을 부검한다고 상상해 보세요.
If someone opened you up right now, what objects, what memories, or what animals would they find inside you?
누군가 지금 당신을 열어 본다면, 어떤 물건, 어떤 기억, 어떤 동물을 발견할까요?

phrases: As one does on New Year's Eve.

quiz.q: What is the main question the hosts try to answer?
options: When your life is completely shattered, how do you keep living?
quiz.explain: When your life is completely shattered, how do you keep living? Do you run from it, dissect it, or become something else?

quiz.q: Why does Tomás walk backward in part one?
options: As a protest — with his back to the world and to God
He is looking for his son
quiz.explain: Martel writes that Tomás walks with his back to the world, his back to God. He is objecting.

quiz.q: What is Tomás looking for in the High Mountains of Portugal?
options: A crucifix carved by Father Ulisses
quiz.explain: He carved a very specific, highly unusual crucifix… Tomás becomes obsessed with finding it.

quiz.q: Why do the hosts say the car is a brilliant narrative lever?
options: A car forces Tomás, who walks backward, to face forward
It was the first car in the world
quiz.explain: The architecture of a car forces him to look forward, literally, through the windshield.

quiz.q: How does Host A explain Tomás's flat reaction to killing a child?
options: His emotional capacity is maxed out, so he boxes up the horror to survive
quiz.explain: His circuit board is already fried… he stuffs this new, unbearable horror into a mental box, just to survive.

quiz.q: What does Maria's ghost compare Agatha Christie mysteries to?
quiz.explain: She compares the structure of an Agatha Christie whodunit to the structure of the Gospels.

quiz.q: What does Maria Castro want from the autopsy of her husband?
options: To be shown how he lived
quiz.explain: She doesn't want to know how he died. She wants Eusébio to cut him open and show her how he lived.

quiz.q: What does Eusébio find inside Rafael's chest?
options: A chimpanzee, a bear cub, a flute and a piece of a radio
quiz.explain: He finds an old, dusty chimpanzee… a young bear cub… a flute, a piece of a radio.

quiz.q: What does Peter Tovy do after meeting Odo?
options: Adopts Odo, resigns from the Senate and moves to a Portuguese village
quiz.explain: He adopts Odo. He resigns from the Canadian Senate. He sells his house. And he moves to Tuizelo.
"We are risen apes, not fallen angels."

quiz.q: Why are there "no high mountains" in the novel's title, according to Martel?
options: The naming is an act of national vanity; they are mountains in the mind
quiz.explain: He calls the naming of the region an act of national vanity… "They are mountains in the mind."

quiz.q: "You cannot ___ grief in a motor car." (달려서 따돌리다)
quiz.explain: out- + 동사 = ~보다 더 …해서 이기다. outrun = 달려서 따돌리다.
